Returns a paginated feed of a user's public Instagram posts, including reels, photos, videos, and carousels. 2 Firecrawl credits when ScrapeCreators charges its 1 credit; a cache hit or an uncharged empty page costs nothing.

Use this when you know the exact hashtag and want Google-indexed public Instagram posts or reels, optional date filters, and pagination. 2 Firecrawl credits when ScrapeCreators charges its 1 credit; a cache hit or an uncharged empty page costs nothing.

Search Oriane's indexed Instagram posts, captions and engagement. Platform is fixed to Instagram. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 35 credits, default 50 credits, full 65 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.
